messages:
Jordan (AE): Kicking off a thread for Aurora Care POC. They want to validate a custom LoRA on horizon-14b and a lightweight pico-6b for high-throughput endpoints. Need compatibility checklist + quick pricing compare (Hosted vs Dedicated).
Kira (Solutions Eng): @Jordan noted. Key tech questions up front: does the LoRA patch change tokenizer special tokens? is the adapter fused into weights or loaded at runtime? and does pico-6b use a different embedding size?
Jordan (AE): They said the LoRA is a runtime adapter (separate files) and pico-6b is standard vocab but different embedding dim (1536 vs 2048).
Dev (Infra): Embedding dim mismatch matters for embedding route. We can normalize via an embedding projection layer but that adds latency. For KV cache/serving we need to confirm the attention key shape for horizon-14b (seq len target 2048).
Noor (Security): Aurora dropped their security packet. Top asks: DPA + data retention (30 days), SOC2 mention, EU data residency, and for Dedicated they need CMK in their Azure KMS. We support bring-your-own-key for Dedicated and Private — will need onboarding ticket.
Mateo (Product): Also confirm rollout controls: they'd like gradual traffic shifting with shadow mode, and automated eval hooks for hallucination checks on clinical prompts.
Jordan (AE): Timeline: customer wants validate quality + perf in a 10-day POC starting Tuesday. Is that feasible?
Kira (Solutions Eng): Feasible if artifacts arrive by Friday. Rough plan: 1) Hosted sandbox with LoRA runtime to validate quality (48-72h) 2) If perf looks good, spin Dedicated trial capacity for throughput testing (3-7 days).
Dev (Infra): Note: pico-6b q4_0 runs fine on T4s; horizon-14b fp16 needs A10 or A100 for stable p95. If they want quantized horizon variant (q4_0) that's experimental for seq>1024; will need perf validation.
Noor (Security): I'll return the questionnaire with notes: CMK flow (Azure), audit log retention, and recommended Private deploy if they insist on EU-only processing for PHI-equivalent data. Also flag that LoRA adapter files must be integrity-signed on upload.
Jordan (AE): Pricing ask: they want a committed comparison for 200M tokens/mo across mixed load 70% gen / 30% embed. Can we give a ballpark?
Mateo (Product): Provide two lines: Hosted per-token (gen vs embed) and Dedicated reserved pool (monthly commitment mapped to GPUs) with a delta for adapter-runtime overhead.
Kira (Solutions Eng): I'll draft numbers. Also drafting a short onboarding checklist they can follow to speed up onboarding:
```
- Upload model artifacts: HF-style tarball + adapter delta files (.pth/.safetensors) + tokenizer files
- Provide model alias: aurora-horizon-14b-lora-v1 and pico-6b-light-v1
- Provide sample eval prompts (clinical safe set) and embedding use cases
- Indicate allowed rollout: shadow -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with rollback criterion
- Include expected peak QPS and avg token length
```
Jordan (AE): Good. One compatibility worry: adapter runtime uses a custom loading hook (torch dtype casting). Does our serving runtime support custom hooks?
Kira (Solutions Eng): Our hosted runtime forbids arbitrary code execution. We support a whitelist of adapter loading patterns (state_dict apply, merge-on-load). If their LoRA uses a custom hook we'll need them to provide a merged variant or run in Dedicated/Private where we can run their loader in a sandbox.
Dev (Infra): Ops: If they want shared prefix caching between horizon and pico variants we must ensure kv-key compatibility or enable cross-variant mapping. That can be configured but requires a short migration window.
Noor (Security): Also: include required ATO paperwork for Private — they are enterprise, will likely ask for a signed ATO and DPA. I'll attach sample language when I reply.
Jordan (AE): Action items: 1) @Kira produce compatibility + pricing note (ETA Fri) 2) @Noor return questionnaire answers + ATO notes (ETA Thu) 3) @Dev draft Dedicated sizing + lead time (ETA Thu) 4) @Mateo draft POC goal blurb for customer (ETA Fri).
Kira (Solutions Eng): Quick models.json sample I'll send in follow-up for their SREs:
```json
{
  "alias": "aurora-horizon-14b-lora-v1",
  "variants": ["aurora-horizon-14b:fp16","aurora-horizon-14b:q4_0","aurora-pico-6b:fp16"],
  "adapters": [{"name":"clinical-lora","runtime":"merge_on_load"}],
  "embedding_dims": {"aurora-horizon-14b":2048,"aurora-pico-6b":1536}
}
```
Dev (Infra): I'll add autoscale policy sample (burst + steady) and note GPU types.
Noor (Security): Will flag that adapter files must be stored encrypted at rest and signed. Also will request that Redwood provide audit log export for the dedicated pool.
Jordan (AE): I'll draft the customer kickoff email and include both Hosted sandbox timeline and Dedicated lead time. Thanks all.
Mateo (Product): Two final asks from sales: include an explicit dev handoff doc for their SRE (how to handle adapter updates) and a simple cost calc table for procurement.
Jordan (AE): On it. I'll combine everything into the proposal and set the kickoff meeting for Tuesday. Ping me if anything blocks before Friday.
